{{Top|leg}}
A '''calsk''' was the [[Viska (species)|Viska]] ruler of a [[lurinn]] clan. When the incumbent calsk [[Death/Legends|died]], their children would battle to the death to select a new calsk. If the calsk had no children, control of the lurinn passed to another family within the clan.
